slides.visual_description: Module 1 Completion and Mindset Consolidation — Recognize that Module 1 has established the learner's innovator mindset and prepared them to move from system reaction toward system redesign.
slides.narration_text: Congratulations—Module 1 is complete. On one side is system reaction: spending your days responding to whatever the system hands you. On the other side is system redesign: shaping what the system becomes. Compared with a reactive posture, the innovator mindset you’ve built positions you to diagnose problems before you prescribe fixes and to focus on root causes rather than symptoms. By contrast with chasing pain points, you’re now ready to redesign how care is delivered—inside the politics, budgets, and legacy systems you already live in.
slides.narrative_arc: From completion acknowledgment to readiness for the next stage through a concise synthesis of what Module 1 has changed in the learner's posture.
slides.script_notes: Module 1 Completion and Mindset Consolidation — Recognize that Module 1 has established the learner's innovator mindset and prepared them to move from system reaction toward system redesign.

slides.display_title: Bridge from Mindset to Leadership Identity
slides.visual_description: Bridge from Mindset to Leadership Identity — Explain that understanding innovation mindset is insufficient without cultivating the leadership identity, communication, and political skill needed to advance ideas inside a health system.
slides.narration_text: Quick stitch from where you’ve just landed: you’ve built the innovator mindset and begun moving from reaction toward redesign. The main message now is personal—ideas don’t advance themselves in a matrixed system; who you are as a leader determines whether they travel. Mindset is the foundation, leadership identity is the bridge that carries your vision, and political skill is the engine that moves it through relationships and power. This is the crossing we make next.
slides.narrative_arc: From confidence in innovation mindset to recognition of leadership development needs through a bridge from ideas to the identity required to champion them.
slides.script_notes: Bridge from Mindset to Leadership Identity — Explain that understanding innovation mindset is insufficient without cultivating the leadership identity, communication, and political skill needed to advance ideas inside a health system.

slides.display_title: Why Ideas Alone Are Not Enough
slides.visual_description: Why Ideas Alone Are Not Enough — Identify that innovation success in a matrixed health system depends far more on political savvy, communication skills, and leadership identity than on the idea alone.
slides.narration_text: Here’s the rub: the idea isn’t the bottleneck. Success rests far more on political savvy—reading the room, mapping stakeholders, navigating power—and on communication that turns complex concepts into a narrative people want to act on. It also rests on a steady leadership identity others can trust. That’s why the same idea thrives under one champion and stalls under another; the difference is the leader’s ability to move the system.
slides.narrative_arc: From confidence in innovation mindset to recognition of leadership development needs through a bridge from ideas to the identity required to champion them.
slides.script_notes: Why Ideas Alone Are Not Enough — Identify that innovation success in a matrixed health system depends far more on political savvy, communication skills, and leadership identity than on the idea alone.

slides.display_title: Preview of the Leadership Journey Ahead
slides.visual_description: Preview of the Leadership Journey Ahead — Preview that Module 2 will focus on defining leadership identity, communicating vision, and inspiring others to join a cause.
slides.narration_text: So the near‑term work is threefold: define your leadership identity—be clear about what you stand for; communicate a vision that resonates across roles and levels; and inspire others so momentum turns vision into movement. As we enter Module 2, we’ll shape your identity, sharpen your message, and practice coalition‑building. See you in Module 2.
slides.narrative_arc: From confidence in innovation mindset to recognition of leadership development needs through a bridge from ideas to the identity required to champion them.
slides.script_notes: Preview of the Leadership Journey Ahead — Preview that Module 2 will focus on defining leadership identity, communicating vision, and inspiring others to join a cause.
